title: AniMathIO community plugin index
description: Generated by scripts/registry.py index from community-plugins.json and the GitHub releases it points at. The editor fetches this single static file. Never edit it by hand.

plugins.description: One entry per listed plugin that has a verified release, sorted by id. Each entry describes the latest release only.

source_url.description: Human-facing link to the source (browsable page, never downloaded by the editor).

kinds.description: Plugin kinds from the release's plugin.toml.

min_abi.description: api_version from the release's plugin.toml: install only when the host ABI is at least this (same major, minor >=).

version.description: Semantic version of the latest release (= plugin.toml version).

download_url.description: HTTPS URL of the .amplugin release asset on github.com (follows redirects to the GitHub release CDN).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the downloaded file. The editor must reject a download that does not match.

size.description: Size of the .amplugin in bytes; the editor can reject larger downloads.

released_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the release was published.
